title: Woman in Fur Coat by Vintage Car, 1947 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black and white snapshot taken on May 30, 1947, depicting a woman dressed in a heavy dark coat with a thick fur collar standing beside a car. In the background, another late-1940s automobile is parked near large shade trees. This photo captures everyday post-WWII American life, reflecting mid-century automotive culture and women's cold-weather fashion of the late 1940s.
